crossRefs.note: “Brothers and fathers, listen to the defense which I now make to you.”
I answered them that it is not the custom of the Romans to give up any man to destruction before the accused has met…
My defense to those who examine me is this:
For behold, this same thing, that you were grieved in a godly way, what earnest care it worked in you. Yes, what…
It is even right for me to think this way on behalf of all of you, because I have you in my heart, because both in my…
but the latter out of love, knowing that I am appointed for the defense of the Good News.
But sanctify the Lord God in your hearts. Always be ready to give an answer to everyone who asks you a reason…
for Demas left me, having loved this present world, and went to Thessalonica; Crescens to Galatia; and Titus to…
This you know, that all who are in Asia turned away from me, of whom are Phygelus and Hermogenes.
Because of all my adversaries I have become utterly contemptible to my neighbors, a horror to my acquaintances. Those…
They all left him, and fled.
Behold, the time is coming, yes, and has now come, that you will be scattered, everyone to his own place, and you will…
He kneeled down, and cried with a loud voice, “Lord, don’t hold this sin against them!” When he had said this, he fell…

translations.web: At my first defense, no one came to help me, but all left me. May it not be held against them.
translations.bsb: At my first defense, no one stood with me, but everyone deserted me. May it not be charged against them.
translations.kjv: At my first answer no man stood with me, but all men forsook me: I pray God that it may ➔ not be laid to their charge.
translations.asv: At my first defence no one took my part, but all forsook me: may it not be laid to their account.
